title: Course Console tour
intro: Welcome to the Course Console. Everything reads your teacher repos live from GitHub, and nothing is stored outside this browser. Here is a one-minute walk of the shell.

steps.say: The global rail. Dashboard is your home base: a card for every class plus one 'Needs attention' inbox that folds together held AI grades, engine flags, and low attendance across all your classes, with a row for each class that is not loaded yet.

Your classes, grouped by subject. Open one to land on its Overview; the tabs across the top hold the Gradebook, Students, AI Review, Attendance, Reports, and per-class Ops. A class loads only when you open it, and the badge counts held AI grades waiting for your review.
Search everything with Cmd or Ctrl-K: views, loaded classes, activities, students, and quick actions.
Data never refetches on its own. This button refreshes the view you are on; the status bar at the bottom shows the API budget and how fresh the loaded data is.
The attendance QR scanner is its own page, built for a phone bookmark. Scans commit as CSV batches that the teacher repo's verify workflow checks and receipts.
The rule everything else follows: grades, feedback, and delivery only ever leave this console as intent prompts that you run in a Claude Code session. The console never writes a grade by itself.
